# Robolectric end-to-end: state-only assertions via sngl test --platform=
# android --opt testRunner=robolectric.


sngl test --platform=android --opt testRunner=robolectric app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output { kotlin { android } }

component counter node {
    var count = 0
    text(value=string(count))
}

func testStartsAtZero(t Test, c counter) {
    t.assert(c.count == 0)
}

func testIncrement(t Test, c counter) {
    c.count = 5
    t.assert(c.count == 5)
}

window {
}
-- testrun/android/kotlin/app.sngl/counter/1 --
sha256:c4a4f7a9f4258e0573389441a2663c44
{
  "results": [
    {
      "Desc": "Increment",
      "Passed": true
    },
    {
      "Desc": "StartsAtZero",
      "Passed": true
    }
  ]
}
